title: Workflow capabilities
description: What the workflows can do for the repository, and who can set them going.

entities.name: Continuous integration
entities.description: Every pull request is checked: the .dev files validated, each changed game tested and built, and database changes held until they are acknowledged. Deploying is not part of it.
entities.responsibility: Test and build each game a change touches, and refuse database changes nobody has applied. The owner deploys each game from their own machine (npm run deploy).
access: Any pull request runs CI and the Database migration check; the workflows check nobody.
main takes only pull requests, because it requires the Database migration check (AGENTS.md).
The workflows hold no Cloudflare credentials: nothing deploys from GitHub.

relatedViews.relationship: Migrating a database is enforced by its gate.
The workflows and scripts that make it up.
